rationale: Water damage to the policyholder's own home structure and contents caused by failure of the policyholder's internal plumbing system is clearly property damage.
claim_summary: Policyholder Sam Patel (POL-1004) discovered extensive basement flooding upon returning from a work trip caused by a burst supply line under an upstairs bathroom sink that ran for approximately two days. Damage includes two inches of standing water, buckled hardwood flooring, water-soaked drywall up to one foot, and ruined stored boxes across the entire basement. Estimated damage likely exceeds $25,000 and requires immediate adjuster assessment.

case_facts.description: two inches of water across basement; hardwood floor buckled; drywall soaked to one foot; stored boxes ruined
case_facts.cause: burst supply line under upstairs bathroom sink, ran for approximately two days
